Definitions  
   
1. Related to people  
1.1 Driver
The driver is the person:
Who has control over the operation of the vehicle. (See the exceptions).
A drover’is a person who is in charge of animals, and is said to ‘rive’his animals.
In vehicles used for driving instruction, the driver is the person in charge of the aditional controls.
(Página 6 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
4. Vehicles without motor  
 
4.4 Trailer
A non self-propelled vehicle designed and constructed to be towed by a motor vehicle.
Note: light trailers are those with a maximum authorised mass, which does not exceed 750 kg (agricultural trailers are not included within this).
Heavy trailers (non-light trailers) are where the maximum authorised mass exceeds 750 kg.
(Página 8 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
5. Vehicles not considered motor vehicles 
 
5.4 Personal mobility vehicle
Vehicle with one or more wheels for a single occupant and powered exclusively by electric motors that can provide the vehicle with a maximum design speed of between 6 and 25 km/h.
It can only be equipped with a seat or saddle if it have a self-balancing system.
This definition excludes vehicles without a self-balancing system and a saddle, vehicles designed for competition, vehicles for people with reduced mobility and vehicles with an operating voltage exceeding 100 VDC or 240 VAC, as well as those included within the scope of Regulation (EU) no. 168/2013: scooters with seat, pedal-assist bicycles, etc.
(Página 9 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
6 Automobiles  
   
6.1 Motorcycle
The following automobiles are considered motorcycles and are defined according to specific characteristics as follows:  
6.1.1 Motorcycle with two wheels
An automobile with two wheels, without a sidecar, that has at least one of the following characteristics:
An internal combustion engine (motor), with a cylinder capacity exceeding 50 cm3.
Constructed to reach, a speed in excess of 45 km/h.
(Página 9 del manual 'Learning to drive')

6 Automobiles  
   
6.1 Motorcycle
The following automobiles are considered motorcycles and are defined according to specific characteristics as follows:  
6.1.2 Motorcycle with sidecar
An automobile with three asymmetric wheels and that has at least one of the following characteristics:
An internal combustion engine (motor), with a cylinder capacity exceeding 50 cm3.
Constructed to reach, a speed in excess of 45 km/h.
 
(Página 9 del manual 'Learning to drive')
